candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [Infinite.{u_1 + 1} k] {V : Type u_2} [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k V] [Module.Finite.{u_1, u_2} k V] (n : Nat),
  Eq.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
    (Submodule.span.{u_1, max u_2 u_1} k
      (Set.range.{max u_2 u_1, u_2 + 1} fun g =>
        PiTensorProduct.map.{0, u_1, u_2, u_2} fun x => LinearEquiv.toLinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} g))
    (DFunLike.coe.{(max u_1 u_2) + 1, (max u_1 u_2) + 1, (max u_1 u_2) + 1} Subalgebra.toSubmodule.{u_1, max u_1 u_2}
      (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u_1, u_2} k V n))

source_text: Over any infinite field, the linear span of the diagonal tensor powers of units is the full diagonal action image.
